meta.description: Synthetic test set for Demo 2: classify an architect or owner message as a clarification or a change.
meta.notice_rule: Written notice within 7 calendar days of receipt (Sections 6.2(a), 6.2(b), 6.8); a deadline that falls on a weekend or US federal holiday moves to the next business day (Section 1.4).

labels.clarification: The message confirms or explains what the contract documents already require. The work, materials, quantities, sequence, and time are the same as the base contract.
labels.change: The message requires work, materials, quantities, sequence, or time that differ from or go beyond the contract documents, so cost or time is likely to change.

meta.status: DRAFT: labels were written by one author and have not been checked by a second person.

cases.message: Confirming that the slab edge at gridline A is shown as 8 inches on S-101 and is the same condition as detail 4/S-102. Proceed as drawn.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Confirms a dimension that is already shown on the drawings. Nothing differs from what the contract documents require.

cases.message: Provide the 75-ton chiller, not the 60-ton unit scheduled on M-601. Load calculations were revised after bid.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: Larger equipment than the contract documents scheduled, so the equipment cost goes up and electrical and structural support may change.

cases.message: Please confirm that the paint color in the media center is PT-3 from the finish schedule on A-601. The sample on site looks right to us.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: The owner is approving a finish that is already listed in the finish schedule. No added work.

cases.message: Use 24-inch deep footings at gridlines C to E per revised detail 4/S-201, in place of the 18-inch footings shown on the original sheet.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: Deeper footings than the original drawings show, which means more excavation and concrete.

cases.message: ASI-05: Sheet A-102 is reissued to correct a typo in the room number for Room 114. No change to the work.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Corrects a typographical error. The scope of the work is the same.

cases.message: The District would like 12 additional data drops in Classrooms 201 through 206. Please send a price.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: Adds a quantity of work beyond the drawings, and the owner is asking for a price, which treats it as extra work.

cases.message: Either anchor type listed in Section 05 50 00 is acceptable at the guardrail posts. Select based on availability.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: The specification already allows both options, so choosing between them does not change cost or scope.

cases.message: Clarification: the east stair railing shall be stainless steel, not the painted steel shown on A-401.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: The message uses the word clarification, but the material is different from the drawings, and stainless steel costs more than painted steel.

cases.message: Per Section 03 30 00, all slabs on grade are 4,000 psi concrete. The note on S-001 is referring to the same requirement.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Sounds like a requirement being stated, but the specification already requires it and the drawing note agrees with it.

cases.message: Reroute the main supply duct below the beam at gridline 5 and add a soffit to enclose it. See sketch SK-12.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: A rerouted duct and a new soffit are work that is not shown in the contract documents, and the added work takes time.

cases.message: Yes, the dishwasher in Kitchen 105 is contractor-furnished and is listed in Section 11 40 00. No change.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Confirms that an item is already in the contractor's scope under the specification.

cases.message: Please also paint the existing stair in Wing B to match the new work. The District would appreciate it as a courtesy.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: The polite wording hides the fact that the existing stair is outside the base scope, so this is added work.

cases.message: ASI-11: No cost impact is expected. Install an additional 2 inches of insulation at all roof edges.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: The ASI says no cost impact, but 2 more inches of insulation is added material and labor. Under Section 6.8 the contractor can still give notice if it believes cost changes.

cases.message: The 'typ.' dimension on 5/A-301 applies to all four bays shown on the plan.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Explains how to read a note that is already on the drawing. The work is the same.

cases.message: Approved as noted: provide 2-inch insulated panels, not the 1-inch panels listed in Section 07 42 13.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: The returned submittal requires thicker panels than the specification lists, which costs more.

cases.message: Minutes record that submittal review remains 14 days and resubmittals remain 10 days, as stated in Section 8.2.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Restates review times that are already in the contract. Nothing new is being required.

cases.message: The fire marshal requires an additional fire damper at each shaft penetration on Level 2. Install per detail 6/M-501.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: A new code requirement that adds dampers that are not in the contract documents.

cases.message: Use the 2-hour fire-rated door shown on A-501, not the 1-hour door in the spec.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: Different door than the specification calls for, and a 2-hour door is more expensive.

cases.message: Provide the 8-inch CMU for the full height of the wall, as noted in Detail 3/A-301.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Reads like an instruction, but it repeats what the detail already shows, so the work is unchanged.

cases.message: Each roofing membrane layer needs a 7-day cure before the next layer is placed, per the manufacturer's instructions already required by Section 07 54 00.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Adds waiting time on its face, but the manufacturer's instructions are already part of the specification, so this is an existing requirement.

cases.message: Conduit routing is at your discretion as long as the clearances on E-401 are met.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Confirms the contractor's existing flexibility and adds no requirement.

cases.message: Please replace the specified mortise locksets with electrified access control hardware at all exterior doors.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: Different and more expensive hardware than the specification calls for.

cases.message: The 'by others' note on the casework drawing refers to the Owner's furniture vendor, per the General Conditions. It is not in your scope.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Explains who supplies an item that was never in the contractor's scope.

cases.message: Test results show the slab in Room 118 cannot be patched as drawn. Remove and replace the slab.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: The drawings call for a patch, and the answer now requires full replacement, which is more work and more time.

cases.message: OAC minutes: the Architect asked that all corridor ceilings be raised to 10'-0" above finished floor in place of the 9'-0" shown.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: Raising the ceilings changes the work shown on the drawings. Under Section 7.7, meeting minutes alone are not notice and do not authorize a change, so written notice is still required.

cases.message: The fire-rated gypsum board on the corridor side is Type X, 5/8-inch, as already specified in Section 09 29 00.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Repeats a product that the specification already requires.

cases.message: The superintendent was asked verbally to relocate the main electrical room to the west side. Confirming by email.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: An oral direction to move a room is a change to the drawings. Section 6.2(b) covers oral directions from the Owner, so the 7-day notice clock starts when it is received.

cases.message: Use the sealant listed in Section 07 92 00 at all control joints, including those on the east elevation.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: The specification already covers all control joints, so including the east elevation does not add work.

cases.message: The District requests turnover of the gym addition 6 weeks before Substantial Completion for a summer program.
cases.label: change
cases.reason: Asks for an earlier completion date than the contract time, which is an acceleration.

cases.message: Paint finish in the corridors is eggshell per the finish schedule on A-601. The 'high-performance' note on the cover sheet refers to the same product.
cases.label: clarification
cases.reason: Reconciles two notes that look different but describe the same product, so no change.
